summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K with its 1Q26 consolidated financial statements under IFRS. The filing contains routine quarterly results—net income of R$11.9B, recurring ROE of 22.9%, and credit portfolio of R$1.5T—with no mention of any M&A, restructuring, or special corporate event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, rights offering, liquidation, delisting, or management change. This is a standard earnings release by a foreign issuer, which is ordinary and not a special situation.
